In addition to ongoing $50 AirPods Pro discounts and the new Beats 360 headphones going on sale, today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break focus is on some solid M5 MacBook Air deals. Amazon is taking up to $150 off select mid-tier 13-inch M5 MacBook Air models, while Apple's Certified Refurbished store today has up to $300 off the 15-inch models. Beyond the ongoing $240 discount on the most affordable Apple Studio Display, we also have multiple M4 iPad Air models down by over $100, early Prime Day fall deals, and more.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (originally $249)

Early Amazon Prime Day fall deals: $20 off Apple, Pixel, Anker, Grubhub, and more

Mid-tier 13-inch M5 MacBook Air models now $150 off at Amazon

Beyond the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 deals, Amazon is now giving you a chance to land a mid-tier 13-inch M5 MacBook Air for $150 off.

Amazon is now offering the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and upgraded 1TB of storage down at $1,449 shipped.

Normally priced at $1,599, today's $150 discount marks one of the best deals we've tracked since the price hike a few months ago. While not every color is down at this price, you can land the classic Silver, Sky Blue, and Starlight models for this much.

As far as things go for the M5 MacBook Air lineup, anything with a $150 price drop is a solid deal. While $100 off isn't bad either, we'd really like to see them closer to $150 off, especially on any of the upgraded models.

The base models aren't seeing any notable discounts right now, but Amazon does have the 13-inch model with 24GB of RAM and 1TB of storage sitting at $1,649 shipped — also $150 off.

M5 MacBook Air 15-inch models now up to $300 off at Apple's Certified Refurbished store

While we tracked brand new 13-inch M5 MacBook Air models down at $150 off today over at Amazon, if you're looking to act fast, Apple's Certified Refurbished store has some solid deals on 15-inch models — now up to $300 off. Details below.

Head over to this page and select MacBook Air from the left — that way you'll be able to see all of the M5 models in stock and discounted right now.

However, the real highlights (while supplies last) are the entry-level 15-inch model and the 24GB/1TB model which are $230 and $300 off respectively:

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,269 (originally $1,499 new)
  • Midnight, Silver, Starlight, Sky Blue
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (originally $1,999 new)
  • Midnight, Starlight, Sky Blue

Here's the product details coming directly from Apple's Certified Refurbished store:

  • Rigorous refurbishment process before being sold
  • Covered by Apple's one-year limited warranty
  • Covered by Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare products can be purchased
  • Engraving and gift wrapping not available for refurbished products
  • Limited supply

Apple's most affordable M4 iPad Air models are now $100 off, 1TB version now $150 off

Amazon is now offering multiple configurations of the M4 iPad Air at $100 off. That includes the most affordable 11-inch and 13-inch models, along with one 1TB version that's $150 off.

While some of the discounted color options appear to have limited stock, at the time of writing you'll find a range of configurations with at least $100 off.

Today's deals are largely in line with the most common discounts we've tracked on the most affordable models since the price hike — be sure to keep an eye out for that 1TB version which is now $150 off:

11-inch M4 iPad Air

  • M4 iPad Air 128GB $649 (originally $749)

  • M4 iPad Air 512GB $949 (originally $1,049)
